<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **246** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **33** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cli/src/utils/config.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-bundle-extract.ts`, `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**144** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c2bfa3ef7c24c98434538d4406cc46f90c1d8e47`.

⛔ **25** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **33** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cli/src/utils/config.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-bundle-extract.ts`, `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **7** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `defaultValue (literal, 43 pages)`, `master_detail (literal, 49 pages)`, `objectName (literal, 60 pages)`, `requiredPermissions (literal, 42 pages)`, `sharingModel (literal, 49 pages)`, `snake_case (literal, 55 pages)`, `/api/v1/meta (route, 55 pages)`
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **189** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c2bfa3ef7c24c98434538d4406cc46f90c1d8e47` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `cb067b8a3b4d937161bcbef97a1ecae90e974815` — the merge of head `f4ce756599358ed4ab3bd9944a9425ad3e3fd445` into base `c2bfa3ef7c24c98434538d4406cc46f90c1d8e47`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin cb067b8a3b4d937161bcbef97a1ecae90e974815 && git checkout cb067b8a3b4d937161bcbef97a1ecae90e974815
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c2bfa3ef7c24c98434538d4406cc46f90c1d8e47 f4ce756599358ed4ab3bd9944a9425ad3e3fd445 && git checkout -B drift-repro c2bfa3ef7c24c98434538d4406cc46f90c1d8e47 && git merge --no-ff f4ce756599358ed4ab3bd9944a9425ad3e3fd445

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c2bfa3ef7c24c98434538d4406cc46f90c1d8e47
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c2bfa3ef7c24c98434538d4406cc46f90c1d8e47` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

PR #37366 (PR A of card #37086's fixed cut), base `main`, 120 files, +426 / -349. Read: the card body and its six comments, the PR body, the file list, the net diff against the merge base, the 70 check-runs on this head, ADR-0159 on `main`. Nothing was built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The rename is mechanical. Right.** Every hunk was normalised (`defineForm` to `defineMetadataForm`, `.form.ts` to `.metadata-form.ts`) and compared with the base text. The only hunks that are not that substitution: the changeset, the migration entry, the `SOURCE_FILENAME` test regex in `packages/lint/src/validate-visibility-predicates.test.ts`, the history sentence in the `view.zod.ts` docblock, the suffix constant and its note in `scripts/i18n-bundle-surface.mjs`, one new self-test case in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`, and three `SchemaForm` tests whose imports moved to the top of the file. No behaviour moved.
- **`defineForm` is absent between the two PRs. Right.** The card's cut says "absent between the two PRs, never dual-meaning". On this head the export is gone from `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` and from every barrel in `hits`; the name survives only in history prose, the changeset, the migration entry and ADR-0159.
- **No `*.form.ts` module is left in `packages/spec/src`. Right.** That glob is the one PR B's registry row gives to the `form` type, so a module left behind would be loaded as an item.
- **The suffix constant moved with the files. Right.** `METADATA_FORM_MODULE_SUFFIX = '.metadata-form.ts'` in `scripts/i18n-bundle-surface.mjs` is the one spelling the i18n gates read; the new self-test case pins that `examples/app-crm/src/forms/lead.form.ts` is not a Studio form module.
- **Accept sets: unchanged.** No schema key, enum member or refinement changes. The public-surface change is the export name and the published module paths only.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/37086-define-metadata-form-rename.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/spec`, `lint`, `cli`, `metadata-protocol`, `platform-objects`; `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`; `Metadata-protocol: none`. **Consistent with AGENTS.md**: a non-protocol breaking change ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 disposition. The banner is there, with the FROM and TO mapping the card asks for.
- **One ADR-0087 marker**: `registered define-form-studio-helper-renamed-define-metadata-form`, and the entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.define-form-studio-helper-renamed-define-metadata-form.ts` is in the diff. `Check Changeset` is green on this head.
- **Derived judgment for the seat (judged right):** the card's Done-when says exactly one marker covers the export break and the refusal together. The fixed cut makes that one marker per changeset: this PR's entry covers the rename, PR B's entry covers `defineForm`'s new meaning and the refusal. Neither changeset carries two.
- Nit, no finding: comment-only edits under `ui/packages/app-shell` carry no changeset line; the gate accepts it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flags and open questions.** The dev's report (7183297230) raises two open questions; both are PR B's and both were answered A in 7183329743. None is on this PR.
- **The red checks. The claim in the brief is true.** 70 check-runs: 59 success, 9 skipped, 2 failure. The failures are `Lint · docs & code guards` and its rollup `Lint & Repo Gates`. The job log shows one red gate of 52: `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, one finding, `[unresolved-symbol] docs/adr/0159-...md:109 packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts#defineForm`. PR B declares that symbol again and its same lane is green on `97341d57da84d7143c7990ef72a82fff0e8b77ef`.
- **Escalated to the seat: this PR is not landable alone.** Merged by itself it leaves `main` red on that lane for every other PR until PR B lands. The two must enter `main` as one landing, and this record's PASS does not cover a landing of A without B. PR B's record on its own head is FAIL, so the pair waits.
- **Escalated to the seat, out of this surface:** once PR B lands, ADR-0159:109 resolves green onto a symbol whose meaning is the opposite of the sentence that cites it (the sentence says `defineForm` is not this type's factory). An add-only ADR note is the seat's to order; `docs/adr/**` is in neither diff.
- **Named, not made, and rightly so:** `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` (lines 264 and 318 name `defineForm` as the Studio helper) and `ui/docs/adr/0056` (line 349). Both are outside the card's surface. No `.claude/**` path is in this diff.
- **The dev's out-of-scope finding** (`form:sharing.password`) and the dev's `security_findings: withheld` belong to PR B; see that record.
- **SQL push-down:** no read or write path changes. Nothing to check.

### ④ Design judgment

Against ADR-0159 ruled question 1 (A: the Studio helper gives up the name) and card item 3.

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-registry.ts`, the eighteen `*.metadata-form.ts` modules and the eight barrels: the helper and its modules are renamed together and the registry imports the new paths; no alias, no re-export of the old name, no dual meaning. Holds.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.define-form-studio-helper-renamed-define-metadata-form.ts`: names the old and new spelling and the one-line fix. Holds.
- `packages/spec/src/data/authoring-key-lint.ts`, `data/field.zod.ts`, `ui/dashboard.zod.ts`, `system/i18n-resolver.ts`: comment and path-string edits only. Hold.
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`, `scripts/pm/landing-k.mjs`, `scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs`, `packages/spec/tsup.config.ts`, the three `packages/lint` files: each reads the new suffix or the new name; none keeps the old one as a fallback. Hold.

N1 (nit) — `scripts/i18n-bundle-surface.mjs`: the module note was caught by the replace. It now reads that 17 files carried the suffix "(then `.metadata-form.ts`)" and that "The suffix was `.metadata-form.ts` until ADR-0159 (#37086) gave that spelling to the `form` metadata type". Both should say `.form.ts`. Comment only; PR B does not correct it.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
